<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> The cardinality of finite sets is bounded if the base sort is finite.
> Fix finite_set_decl_plugin.cpp such that when creating a finite_set sort over finite base sort s of finite size,
> then the size of the finite_set sort is 2^|s|, where |s| is the size of sort s.
> If the size of s is beyond 30, set the size of the of the finite_set sort to very large.


</details>
